_comment: Owner switches. adsense.slots: paste the two display ad unit IDs (digits only) from AdSense > Ads > By ad unit > Display ads. Until a unit ID is set its slot stays hidden and reserves no space; the AdSense site script still loads for non-EEA/UK/CH visitors so the site can be reviewed. Do NOT turn on Auto ads for this site: it can place an ad above the gauge. support.url: the pay-what-you-want Stripe Payment Link (lln_support); the support line stays hidden while it is empty.
